name: New Jersey

context: NJ 340: The cover crop standard lists wind erosion reduction as a purpose and ties it to the critical erosion period.
NJ 380: The windbreak protected zone on the leeward side is 10 times the tallest row height (10H); greatest wind reduction is 2H to 10H.
cover_rules: NJ 340: For erosion control a cover crop must give at least 70% soil surface coverage during the critical erosion period.
NJ 340: For late seedings pick fast-germinating covers; annuals germinate faster than perennials and grasses faster than legumes.
barriers: NJ 603: Herbaceous barriers: minimum height 1.5 feet, porosity 40 to 50 percent, perpendicular to wind, spacing not over 10 times barrier height.
NJ 589: Cross wind trap strips: at least 15 feet wide if stubble is 1 foot or more tall, at least 25 feet if under 1 foot.
windbreak: NJ 380: Orient windbreaks as close to perpendicular to damaging wind as possible; protect area within 10H leeward; use two or more species.
disturbed: NJ 342: Sand dune and coastal plants must survive burial by blowing sand, sand blasting, salt spray, drought and heat; use sand fences or brush matting.
